_comment: Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workable/SmartRecruiters/Teamtailor/Personio public-API boards, seeded from career-ops portals.yml + startupmap_discovered.yml by app-seed-export.mjs and kept in sync by `node scripts/sync-boards.mjs --engine=<career-ops> --write` (monthly; verifies liveness, idempotent). Teamtailor entries carry `token` for a *.teamtailor.com subdomain or `host` for a custom career domain. Personio entries carry `token` for a *.jobs.personio.de tenant (the .com mirror serves the same feed). Dead boards fail non-fatally in scrape.mjs.
